Character Design

I do character design and concept art for games, animated series, comics, books and brands: heroes, villains, creatures, mascots, and sometimes a whole cast that has to feel like it grew up in the same world.

I usually start with the silhouette and the posture, because that’s what people remember first. The costume, the face and the small details that tell you who they are come after. You see rough explorations early, we pick a direction together, and then I take it to a finished render: realistic, stylised or cartoon, whatever your project needs.
